title: Item 14b · Picking a time
subtitle: Approved in each section, plus drift. Six different time lists: Color Belt 5-minute steps, 6 AM–10 PM (194 choices — chosen so times like 6:50 fit, v0.157); Star 15-minute, 8 AM–8 PM; Black Belt 15-minute, 6 AM–10 PM; Camps 5-minute, 6 AM–9 PM; Finance's close-the-day reminder 15-minute, 11 AM–11 PM with Off; Schedule and Calendar the browser's own time box. That box is the one that saved Worcester's “4:20” class times as 4:20 AM in October (fixed with SQL, v0.600). Calendar's box was never decided (drift). (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

columns.label: Today

row.caption: 1. Star: its own list — opens at the chosen time, big rows, 15-minute steps (no 4:20).
2. Schedule: the browser's time box — hours, minutes and AM/PM typed in parts. This is what saved 4:20 as AM.

items.caption: 3. Color Belt: the browser's plain drop-down list — 194 times in 5-minute steps (Camps the same kind, 181).

columns.note: Calendar uses the same browser time box as Schedule when “All day” is off.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · one time list everywhere

items.caption: 4. Schedule with the shared list: Star's list in 5-minute steps, AM/PM written on every time, opening at the chosen time — 4:40 PM can't turn into AM.

columns.note: Copies what's already there: Star's own list (it already opens at the chosen time) with Color Belt's 5-minute steps. The range fits the job: 6:00 AM–10:00 PM for classes, testing and camps; Finance's reminder keeps 11 AM–11 PM and “Off”. Picture 4 is drawn over the real Add time slot box; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep as today. + no work. − six different lists; Schedule and Calendar keep the box that turned 4:20 into 4:20 AM.
B · Recommended: one time list everywhere (picture 4). Star's list, in 5-minute steps, with AM/PM written on every time and the list opening at the chosen time; Schedule and Calendar drop the browser's box. + the same way to pick a time in every section; real times like 4:20 and 6:50 fit; no AM/PM mix-ups. − work in every section with a time; Star's and Black Belt's lists get longer (they open at the chosen time, so it matters little).
C · Fix only the risky box: Schedule and Calendar switch to a list; every other section keeps its own. + the least work; the AM/PM mix-up can't happen again. − five different lists stay.
